events.content:
Done on branch `cache-components`:

- `next.config.ts` — legacy `experimental.dynamicIO` replaced with top-level `cacheComponents: true`
- `app/news/page.tsx` — route-segment `revalidate` removed; `getStories()` now uses `'use cache'` + `cacheLife({ revalidate: 3600 })`, keeping the hourly refresh
- `app/preview/page.tsx` — `force-dynamic` removed; cookie read moved into a `<Suspense>` boundary so it stays request-specific

Production build passes with no route-segment opt-outs: `/news` prerenders static (Revalidate 1h), `/preview` is a partial prerender with streamed dynamic content. Smoke-tested: `/preview` returns "Untitled draft" without the cookie and "My Draft" with it. Changes are uncommitted — say the word if you want them committed.

shellCommands.command: find app -type f | head -50 && cat package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json

(npx next start -p 3100 &>/tmp/next-start.log &) && sleep 3 && curl -s localhost:3100/news | head -c 300; echo; curl -s localhost:3100/preview | grep -o 'Untitled draft'; curl -s -H 'Cookie: draft-title=My%20Draft' localhost:3100/preview | grep -o 'My Draft'; kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
